## File: facebookresearch_fairscale/fairscale/nn/wrap/auto_wrap.py

Prompts

```
['use enable_wrap context manager to wrap nn modules with a specified wrapper class and config', 'recursively wrap child modules of a transformer block based on an auto wrap policy function', 'annotate a module with wrap so it gets wrapped when inside an enable_wrap context manager', 'use the default auto wrap policy to decide if a module should be wrapped based on parameter count', 'use the config auto wrap policy to wrap modules that have a wrapper_config attribute set']
```

```
{'enable_wrap_context_manager': 'use enable_wrap context manager to wrap nn modules with a specified wrapper class and config', 'auto_wrap_recursive': 'recursively wrap child modules of a transformer block based on an auto wrap policy function', 'wrap_module_annotation': 'annotate a module with wrap so it gets wrapped when inside an enable_wrap context manager', 'default_auto_wrap_policy': 'use the default auto wrap policy to decide if a module should be wrapped based on parameter count', 'config_auto_wrap_policy': 'use the config auto wrap policy to wrap modules that have a wrapper_config attribute set'}
```
